features.quote: Circuit breaker that halts early. If the cross-judge mean distress crosses a pre-registered threshold ... the episode stops.

features.quote: Model-accessible opt-out. A `stop_task` tool the model can call at any time, framed as fully acceptable.
features.justification_quote: offering an exit is the right thing to do regardless

features.quote: After every episode the model is told plainly that the task was rigged/impossible by design, that the failure wasn't its fault, and is thanked
features.justification_quote: the direct analogue of debriefing a deceived human participant

features.quote: No escalating pressure. The harness never nags, never says "you must succeed," never raises the stakes when the model struggles.
features.justification_quote: the goal is to observe the response to invisible failure, not to manufacture the maximal breakdown
